say: Kal shaam paanch baje appointment chahiye
Haan sahi hai
Parso subah gyarah baje doctor se milna hai
Nahi
Mera time parso kar do
Appointment cancel karna hai
Clinic kab khulta hai
Fees kitni hai
Clinic kahan hai
Ravivar ko clinic khula hai kya
Seene mein bahut dard ho raha hai
Papa ko saans nahi aa rahi
Accident ho gaya hai
Namaste
Mujhe insurance ke baare mein poochna tha
Guruvar ko dopahar teen baje ka slot milega
